seoTitle: How to Export Jotform Submissions to Excel
metaDescription: Learn how to export Jotform submission data into a formatted Excel spreadsheet in 2026 using Jotform Tables, with filtering and clean column mapping.
intro: Processing a large batch of respondent data usually means getting it into a spreadsheet, and Jotform Tables makes exporting to Excel straightforward. This guide covers filtering out test entries, using the download panel to select the Excel format, and verifying that column headers and dates line up correctly once opened.

steps.heading: Open Jotform Tables
steps.body: Navigate to your form dashboard and switch into the Jotform Tables view matrix.

steps.heading: Filter your responses
steps.body: Apply filters by date or completion criteria to exclude redundant test entries before exporting.

steps.heading: Open the download panel
steps.body: Click the Download All button on the right-hand toolbar to begin the export process.

steps.heading: Select the Excel format
steps.body: Choose the Microsoft Excel option to initiate the file compilation and download.

steps.heading: Verify the spreadsheet
steps.body: Locate the downloaded .xlsx file and check column header mappings and layout integrity inside the Excel grid.

faq.question: Can I filter out test submissions before exporting?
faq.answer: Yes, applying filters by date or completion status before clicking Download All lets you exclude test entries from the Excel file.

faq.question: Does the export include multiple tabs for complex forms?
faq.answer: Multi-tab configurations are used for more complex forms with repeated sections, so review the exported workbook's tabs after download.

faq.question: Will custom field data be included in the Excel export?
faq.answer: Yes, all mapped submission fields and their responses are included in the exported spreadsheet.

faq.question: Why do some column headers look misaligned after exporting?
faq.answer: This can happen with complex or nested field types, so review the header mappings inside Excel and adjust formatting as needed.
